_comment: Where this project's Conan packages come from. Read this before adding a dependency.
remote -- the normal case. A package ConanCenter (or any configured remote) carries is
declared once, by version, in conandata.yml; there is nothing to keep here.
local  -- a package no remote carries. Keep the BUILT artifact under local-packages/ and
describe it here; `python3 .github/project/package_sources.py` turns it into a
package in the local cache. The packaging recipe is generated, has no download
step, and so no URL or upstream sha256 ever enters the version library.
An absent local package is not an error: the leg that needs it says so and is skipped, which
is what lets a clean clone build.

packages.name: cmsis-nn
packages.if_absent: the leg that enables compile_options.with_cmsis_nn is skipped and says which local package it wanted; every other leg is unaffected
